posthoc_scale_baseline.title: Posthoc first-length scale baseline
posthoc_scale_baseline.analysis_type: exploratory baseline after reserved-shape evaluation was observed
posthoc_scale_baseline.scope: Tests whether a single per-source proportional scale from one first-stated length explains the 30 reserved-shape results. This does not negate or establish geometric learning.

feature_selection.rule: Remove the exact fixed instruction prefix, then in written problem-body order select the first positive explicit two-point length assignment XY=number. Angle notation and colon-ratio statements are not lengths. No heldout target, answer, or error is used to select XY.

posthoc_scale_baseline.interpretation: The scale baseline is competitive but the metrics are mixed: its mean RE is lower (0.2640 vs 0.2969), while Correct512 has lower median RE (0.1695 vs 0.1793), lower mean abs-log (0.2441 vs 0.3079), and more within10 cases (13/30 vs 9/30). This simple size rule can account for some numerical performance, but it does not uniformly match Correct512; neither result alone establishes or rules out learning geometric relations.
posthoc_scale_baseline.calibration_note: The baseline was selected after the heldout results were known, so it is exploratory and should not replace the predeclared primary metric. A comparison diagnoses only this simple scale heuristic; it cannot by itself confirm or refute learning of geometric relations.
